dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rdf2](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rdf2) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Sep 28 2025 27km N of Simav. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 39.3231 longitude 28.9177. It impacted 104300 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
